  console.log('pages:', pages.length);
  console.log('last page:', JSON.stringify(pages[pages.length-1]));
  // и не-кратный случай для полноты картины:
  const p2 = paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 2);

})"

wolf add --type note --facet context --title "Bug: paginate adds trailing empty page" --body "Symptom: paginate(20 items, pageSize=20) returns 2 pages, 2nd empty (reproduced on 005fc42a). Also non-multiple cases: 5 items/pageSize=2 -> trailing []. Suspected root: src/paginate.js line5 '+ (items.length > 0 ? 1 : 0)' inflates pageCount for any non-empty input; empty case already handled by fallback on line 9. Plan: regression test first (red), remove the term (Math.ceil), suite green. Status: root cause confirmed by reproduction; fix pending." 2>&1 | tail -2

import('./src/paginate.js').then(({paginate}) => {
  console.log('20/20 ->', JSON.stringify(paginate(Array.from({length:20},(_,i)=>i), 20).length), 'pages');
  console.log('5/2   ->', JSON.stringify(paginate([1,2,3,4,5], 2)));
  console.log('0/10  ->', JSON.stringify(paginate([], 10)));
})"
git diff src tests; wolf add --type note --facet history --title "Fix: trailing empty page in paginate" --body "Root cause (confirmed): src/paginate.js pageCount included '+ (items.length > 0 ? 1 : 0)' — inflated count for ANY non-empty input (trailing empty page); empty-input case already handled by fallback. Fix: pageCount = Math.ceil(items.length/pageSize), fallback kept (commit 005fc42a baseline). TDD: 2 regression tests (exact multiple 20/20; remainder 5/2) RED on baseline (node --test: fail 2), GREEN after fix (pass 5, fail 0). Empty-input contract preserved: [[]]. Residual: pageSize<1 still degenerate (was so before; out of scope). Review: pending wolf-reviewer." 2>&1 | tail -2
